fullDesc: Starbucks opened its first store at Pike Place Market in Seattle in 1971, founded by Jerry Baldwin, Zev Siegl and Gordon Bowker. Howard Schultz bought the company in 1987 and expanded it into a global coffeehouse chain.
realFacts: Schultz bought it for $3.8 million in 1987
It has tens of thousands of stores worldwide
It popularised the specialty coffee drink
